verdict.rationale: Gmail documents search operators for filtering search results (gmail-docs-12) and supports searching mail offline (gmail-docs-9), which covers the precision and operator parts of the story. Filters that match on criteria like sender, subject, or size (gmail-docs-28) are related, but they are rules for incoming mail rather than search tools. Missing for 10: evidence of search speed, ranked or relevance-ordered results, explicit coverage of the full mail history, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
